name: myio
description: Work with a myIO smart home controller: answers from the official myIO documentation, step-by-step troubleshooting and, in Claude Code, reading and controlling your own controller over the home network.

base_url.title: myIO controller URL
base_url.description: Address of your myIO controller, for example http://192.168.1.178. Leave empty if you fill in Several controllers.

username.title: myIO user name
username.description: A myIO user; its permissions limit what Claude can read and change

password.title: myIO password
password.description: Password of that myIO user (kept in the system's secure credential store)

name.title: Controller label
name.description: Name used for this controller in Claude's replies

servers.title: Several controllers (optional)
servers.description: For more than one controller: a JSON array such as [{"name":"Ground floor","url":"http://192.168.1.178","username":"admin","password":"..."}]. Overrides the URL, user name and password above.

write_level.title: Write level
write_level.description: What Claude may change: state (switch only), config (also settings) or admin (also users, network, updates)

toolsets.title: Tool groups
toolsets.description: Tool groups to load, for example house,automation (all = every group)
